mapper.select: WITH year_range AS ( SELECT MIN(YEAR(TIME)) AS min_year, YEAR(CURDATE()) AS max_year FROM screen_left_three_data ) SELECT min_year + n AS `value`, CONCAT(min_year + n, '年') AS `name` FROM year_range JOIN ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 ) numbers WHERE min_year + n <= max_year ORDER BY `value`;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `value`, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n MONTH), '%Y年%m月') AS `name` FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 ) numbers ORDER BY `value`;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', n, '-01')), '%Y-%m') AS `value`, DATE_FORMAT(DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', n, '-01')), '%Y年%m月') AS `name` FROM ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 ) numbers WHERE n <= MONTH(CURDATE()) ORDER BY `value`;

WITH year_range AS ( SELECT MIN(YEAR(TIME)) AS min_year, YEAR(CURDATE()) AS max_year FROM screen_left_three_data ), all_years AS ( SELECT min_year + n AS `year` FROM year_range JOIN ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 ) numbers WHERE min_year + n <= max_year ), group_data AS ( SELECT m.id, m.title, m.color_one AS color, y.year, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(d.value), 2), 0) AS year_value FROM screen_left_three_main m CROSS JOIN all_years Y LEFT JOIN screen_left_three_data d ON d.group_id = m.id AND YEAR(d.time) = y.year WHERE m.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT group_id FROM screen_left_three_data) GROUP BY m.id, m.title, m.color_one, y.year ORDER BY m.id, y.year ) SELECT id, title AS `name`, JSON_ARRAYAGG(year_value) AS datas, color FROM group_data GROUP BY id, title, color;

WITH last_12_months AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 ) numbers ORDER BY month_start DESC ), group_data AS ( SELECT m.id, m.title, m.color_one as color, l.month_start, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(d.value), 2), 0) AS month_value FROM screen_left_three_main m CROSS JOIN last_12_months l LEFT JOIN screen_left_three_data d ON d.group_id = m.id AND DATE_FORMAT(d.time, '%Y-%m-01') = l.month_start WHERE m.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT group_id FROM screen_left_three_data) GROUP BY m.id, m.title, m.color_one, l.month_start ORDER BY m.id, l.month_start ) SELECT id, title AS name, JSON_ARRAYAGG(month_value) AS datas, color FROM group_data GROUP BY id, title, color;

WITH current_year_months AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', n, '-01')), '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start FROM ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 ) numbers WHERE n <= MONTH(CURDATE()) ORDER BY month_start ), group_data AS ( SELECT m.id, m.title, m.color_one as color, c.month_start, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(d.value), 2), 0) AS month_value FROM screen_left_three_main m CROSS JOIN current_year_months c LEFT JOIN screen_left_three_data d ON d.group_id = m.id AND DATE_FORMAT(d.time, '%Y-%m-01') = c.month_start WHERE m.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT group_id FROM screen_left_three_data) GROUP BY m.id, m.title, m.color_one, c.month_start ORDER BY m.id, c.month_start ) SELECT id, title AS name, JSON_ARRAYAGG(month_value) AS datas, color FROM group_data GROUP BY id, title, color;
